row.notes: myteam-g2: Reads the player driver contract list (func 142457460), keeps contracts with the active flag (+0x4b & 0x10) and checks whether an activity record with the driver key (+0xc0) exists in the current activity slot lists (comp+0x410, 0x80 stride; 200- and 0xd8-byte entries).
